'''Hill Smasher''' is an [[Elite enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A criminal armed with a heavy weapon. The name may sound like an exaggerated joke, but the Hill Smasher's quadruple rocket launcher delivers serious firepower. Do not underestimate this foe.}}
